Default Settings for the API Potsdam Booking Page

Source: R/config.R
api_potsdam_config.Rd

The settings are taken from the public online booking page of the outpatient clinic of the "Akademie fuer Psychotherapie und Interventionsforschung" (API) in Potsdam, which is provided by samedi: https://termin.samedi.de/b/akademie-fur-psychotherapie-und-interventionsforschung-gmbh/1/api

Usage

api_potsdam_config()

Value

named list with elements

  • practice_slug: practice identifier in the booking page URL

  • widget: booking widget number in the booking page URL

  • category_slug: "Behandler/Kategorie" identifier in the booking page URL ("API, Potsdam")

  • booking_base_url: base URL of the booking page

  • api_url: base URL of the samedi booking API used by the booking page

Examples

api_potsdam_config()
#> $practice_slug
#> [1] "akademie-fur-psychotherapie-und-interventionsforschung-gmbh"
#> 
#> $widget
#> [1] "1"
#> 
#> $category_slug
#> [1] "api"
#> 
#> $booking_base_url
#> [1] "https://termin.samedi.de"
#> 
#> $api_url
#> [1] "https://patient.samedi.de/api/booking/v3"
#>
